sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Defines the structural blueprint for security controls across identity, network, and cloud domains. Incorporates principles like Zero Trust, least privilege, and secure-by-design. Aligns architecture with business and regulatory requirements. Includes diagrams, component descriptions, and integration flows. Serves as a foundation for secure solution deployment (IAM, Zero Trust, Cloud, etc.).

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Enables consistent and scalable security implementation. Reduces complexity and risk in multi-platform environments. Supports compliance and audit readiness. Enhances agility in responding to threats and changes. Builds trust in digital transformation initiatives.
